consumer: The engine's courier mission/job-completion check (the mission step's is-complete predicate) that the frontend reads to ask 'is this job ready to hand in?'
scope: The mission's own completion condition (the specific required mission item/quantity/turn-in step the engine tracks), not the avatar's on-person carried inventory
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — iterates ctx.u.wielded_items(), ctx.u.worn, and ctx.u.inv_const_slice() and emits raw item state (type_id/charges/location), never invoking any mission/job completion predicate
divergence: Avatar carries an item of the same type as the courier package but it is the wrong specific mission item (or the real package sits in an adjacent tile/vehicle, or completion also requires reaching the recipient): carried_items reports 'have it / ready' while the engine's mission predicate reports not-complete
